what: §7.3a 'lose the car with a detached wheel' (P1-S04c, amended by R121 2026-10-10: one wheel is enough, and the car gets a grace; the row keeps P1-S04c's name): a car at 12 m/s on the main straight, a little throttle, loses its front left wheel at 0.5 s (tick 60 of 120 Hz). It drives on for the profile's wheel_loss_respawn_s (2 s), still moving and upright, unwrecked; then it is wrecked: every remaining part pops off as debris, its chassis stays on the track as a husk (a dynamic body), and the player is back at their anchor, upright on a fresh intact car with the same identity, after a 1 s hold, rolling off it (R125). Baselines: no input and mashing wreck it just the same, so what differs is the deliberate run driving the fresh car off its anchor again once the hold is over.
